about: I started in Unity, freelancing for clients while still at college, then moved to Unreal Engine and C++ at Pole To Win, building engine modules and mentoring engineers new to Unreal.

After an MSc in Computer Games Engineering with Distinction, I brought Unreal Engine 5 rendering to Apple Vision Pro at Tencent. I now build optimization tooling at Samsung, and spend my own time on a Vulkan engine.
